mechanism: Anchor visual iteration to an explicit target and an actual current render; distinguish composition, lighting, materials and fine detail; recognize stalled changes and preserve the best verified result.
productionProposal: A small optional render-observation extension to Muse, not a new mandatory loop. Use achievable target states and real interaction evidence alongside screenshots. Make the visible gap capable of changing the next action.
existingOverlap: Muse already freezes capture conditions, budgets GPU cost and checks multiple states. The useful addition is a concise target/current/gap packet and an explicit rule for abandoning ineffective visual tweaks.
rejectOrAdapt: Reject subscription-tier/model-prestige routing, compulsory subagents, pixel identity to a generated image, unbounded score chasing, and a judge score as sole acceptance. Generated targets require applicable tool authority and must not erase user constraints.
dependenciesAndRisks: Reference workflow depends on image generation, screenshot access, optional independent model calls and 3D tooling; these can dominate cost. A beautiful single frame may hide broken geometry, focus or motion.
qualification: Compare native and optional extension on an unseen interactive 3D task with the same budget. Include orbit views, keyboard focus, animation, reduced motion and frame-time measurements. Freeze subjective and behavioral criteria before generation, retain regressions and total cost.

mechanism: Deliver editable source assets, a layered offline scene and a working interactive viewer together. Preserve identity and framing across alternate artwork states. Check front/angled views and the actual exported browser artifact rather than assuming offline success transfers.
productionProposal: Generalize a cross-renderer asset handoff: source/derived relationships, coordinate conventions, state invariants, export limitations, freshness and failure propagation. Keep stylistic choices user-owned and use it beyond collectible cards.
existingOverlap: Muse already requires multi-state visual acceptance. This source supplies a concrete editable asset chain and a regression fixture for stale outputs after a failed child process.
rejectOrAdapt: Do not impose anime/ukiyo-e styling, fixed white viewers, automatic package installation or generated imagery for every task. Do not claim pixel equivalence between Blender and a browser renderer.
dependenciesAndRisks: Full pipeline uses Python, Pillow, Blender, image generation and Node/browser dependencies. Only the dispatcher and named tests were inspected, not the full transitive pipelines. The stale-output test explicitly skips Windows, so it is not Windows qualification.
qualification: Test a real source-to-export round trip, missing textures, wrong orientation, A/B identity drift, invalid route, failed child with old artifacts present, narrow viewport and tilted views. Require a Windows-appropriate failure fixture and actual renderer checks before reuse.

inspectionLimit: Architecture introduction through processing was read; later sections and implementation not audited.
mechanism: Separate cheap candidate discovery from expensive investigation, preserve the requested diff/full scope through setup, and resume only phases whose input digest and output remain current. Distinguish findings from infrastructure failures and revalidation from first discovery.
productionProposal: Refine Aegis review planning with an explicit coverage denominator and resumable task boundary. A cached phase is reusable only when its inputs and actual outputs still match; completion of setup must not accidentally authorize full-repository paid processing.
existingOverlap: Aegis already separates scanner leads from proven findings and has a static-rule proof contract. Add a mechanism only where scope preservation or stale-phase recovery is absent, not another scanner wrapper.
rejectOrAdapt: No automatic npx install, auth, Vercel setup, cloud fanout or provider spend. Do not adopt blanket sandbox claims from documentation. Zero findings do not establish exhaustive security coverage.
dependenciesAndRisks: Upstream uses model SDKs, optional cloud execution, matchers and credentials. Source review here covers skill runbooks and partial architecture, not executable containment or correctness.
qualification: Use local fixtures with a known vulnerable path, a clean negative, a missed surface, interrupted processing and input drift. Check that retry preserves scope and budget and that unresolved findings or missing coverage cannot be reported as clean.

mechanism: Gather missing factual inputs without inventing dates, credentials or achievements; keep content separate from layout; emit a structured document for a named consumer schema.
productionProposal: A reusable evidence-to-document method for resumes, portfolios and professional profiles, with claim-to-source traceability and schema validation. Treat the consumer schema as an adapter, not the universal document format.
existingOverlap: Existing writing capabilities already require truthful claims. The useful narrow candidate is enforcing a fact ledger through structured export, not a new broad writing skill.
rejectOrAdapt: Do not ask again for supplied facts, enforce a particular template, automatically modify application records, send messages or upload personal data. The entrypoint's abbreviated JSON example is illustrative, not a valid executable fixture.
dependenciesAndRisks: Actual upstream schema/reference and application tools were not audited. User personal information must remain within authorized storage and publication scope.
qualification: Use synthetic biographies with missing and conflicting dates, unsupported numeric achievements and partial sections. Require exact factual preservation, valid target schema and readable rendered output; ensure no send/upload occurs without scope.

mechanism: Retrieve the rationale and accepted tradeoffs behind a prior decision; avoid storing routine actions or facts already durable in repository history.
productionProposal: Retain as a retrieval-evaluation scenario for Mnemosyne, not an added memory service or mandatory wake/save step. Test whether a short source-linked rationale prevents unnecessary re-investigation.
existingOverlap: Mnemosyne already separates active/durable/evidence/archive layers, rejects routine checkpointing and tests retrieval freshness. No demonstrated missing runtime capability from this source alone.
rejectOrAdapt: Do not adopt automatic memory writes, hosted transcript upload, global search without task scope, or claims that semantic retrieval is always better. Reject the separate internal stats workflow, which targets upstream production accounts, credentials and customer data.
dependenciesAndRisks: Upstream memory service/MCP and semantic retrieval are dependencies of its workflow, not this intake. Licence is BSL-1.1 with a Memory Service restriction, SDK subtree separately MPL-2.0; no code or body text is imported.
qualification: Compare with current Mnemosyne on synthetic task-scoped histories with stale decisions, contradictory rationales, another project's similar names, no-match queries and duplicate saved material. Measure correct resolution and context cost without any memory writes.
